name: State Variable Filter
description: LP, BP, HP and notch modes with resonance up to Q=30.

name: Digital Low Pass Gate
description: Buchla-style low-pass gate with a simulated vactrol response.

name: Compressor
description: Feed-forward compressor with a gate sidechain.

name: Wavefolder
description: West-coast style folding with symmetry control.

name: Delay
description: Tap tempo and clock sync with straight, triplet and dotted ratios.

name: Tape
description: Endless tape loop from plain echo to continuously piling sound.

name: Chorus
description: Chorus, flanger and vibrato from a single modulated delay line.

name: Spring
description: Spring-style dispersion using forty allpasses per spring.

name: Freeverb
description: Schroeder-Moorer reverb with room size and damping.

name: Harmonizer
description: Characterful pitch shifting with splice crossfades and feedback.

name: Autotune
description: Pitch tracking and correction on the MOD2 hardware.

name: Sampler
description: Auto-triggered recording, playable at any speed in either direction.

name: Granular
description: Rolling grain buffer with constant overlap scheduling and freeze.

name: Calibrate
description: Measure the per-unit ADC BIAS and verify the input path is alive.
